comparisonArms.description: same supported client and workload with Legion disabled
same client and workload using current Node Legion release
same client and workload using signed installed native Legion release

controls: same client configuration except Legion enablement
randomized arm order after one warm-up

workloads.procedure: Start client session, allow MCP initialization, perform no Legion operation for 10 minutes.
Measure client launch through usable session and Legion MCP ready.
Run 100 deterministic lightweight Legion operations through one client session.
Run the fixed representative Audit corpus with Blueprint present and absent.
Run the fixed representative Research workload and evidence ledger production.
Cancel a bounded long operation at fixed checkpoints and then reuse or restart the client-owned MCP process.
Close client, crash MCP process once, and restart client.

processInvariant.required: exactly one reusable client-owned legion serve --stdio process per active client session
processInvariant.allowed: one separate reusable process for each concurrently active client

passThresholds.semanticResultParity: 100 percent for the fixed corpus, excluding explicitly typed optional-provider degradation
passThresholds.nativeOverhead: Native Legion must materially reduce the Node Legion overhead versus client-only on a predeclared composite of startup delta, repeated-operation CPU time, and peak RSS; material means at least 20 percent improvement in two metrics and no regression greater than 5 percent in the third on each reference platform/client.
passThresholds.latency: Native p95 repeated-operation latency must not regress more than 5 percent versus Node Legion.
passThresholds.cancellation: No state corruption; p95 acknowledgement and cleanup complete within the operation's declared timeout budget.

decisionRule: Legacy deletion is forbidden until signed installed native artifacts pass every invariant and threshold on macOS and Windows. Raw samples, summaries, process trees, and environment metadata are retained together.
cargoPolicy: No Cargo command or benchmark is run during M0.
